title: Suriyupamā
text: 2. Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittam yad idam aruṇuggam || evam eva kho bhikkhave catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi || || 3. Sammādiṭṭhikassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno patikaṅkhaṃ Idam dukkhan ti yathābhutam pajānissati || la-pe || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānissati || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāmiṇī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
